howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. TIFF preserves transparency and is accepted by archival and prepress software that has no idea what WebP is.

faq.q: Does WebP to TIFF lose quality?
faq.a: If your WebP is lossy, TIFF can't restore discarded detail; if it's lossless WebP, the TIFF is pixel-identical. Either way TIFF gives you the lossless container that print and archival tools expect.

faq.q: Why not just keep the WebP?
faq.a: Many print, scanner, and legacy desktop applications don't read WebP at all. TIFF is universally supported by those workflows.
